**Three [[Hiking|hikers]] are killed, two are missing and 15 more rescued after the [[Volcanic eruption|eruption]] of Mount Dukono on [[Halmahera]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/5/8/indonesia-volcano-kills-three-as-search-for-missing-hikers-continues (Al Jazeera)]
